name: Joplin Server
description: Sync server for the Joplin note-taking apps: keeps your notes, notebooks and attachments in sync across all your devices.
compose:
services:
  joplin:
    image: joplin/server:latest
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:${{cfg.port}}:22300"
    environment:
      APP_PORT: "22300"
      APP_BASE_URL: "https://${{cfg.domain}}"
    volumes:
      - ./data:/home/joplin/.config/joplin
    restart: unless-stopped
